system.description:
Tortrum Traits

Characters with the tortrum heritage share a variety of traits with one another.

Age. Tortrum age and mature much slower than most humanoids. They are considered to be adults when they reach the age of 50 and typically reach ages of 150–300 years.

Size. Tortrum are of a similar size to humans but their large shells and thick limbs make them appear far larger. Their shells also make them much heavier, with the average tortrum weighing more than 300 lbs. Your size is Medium.

Speed. Your base Speed is 30 feet.

Protective Shell. You have a large, bony shell that is fused to your spine. This shell may be smooth or covered in spines or even strikingly patterned, though its coloration typically matches that of your scales. Because of this, you cannot wear armor made for most humanoids, though you may use shields if you are proficient and benefit from magic items that raise your AC. Your shell is still hard and thick, however, and provides you some measure of protection. Your AC is equal to 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier.

Wisdom of the Ages. You gain two specialties in lore skills of your choosing, and you gain a new specialty any time your proficiency bonus increases. These specialties are in addition to those specialties that you would gain from your level and your Intelligence modifier.

Tortrum Gifts

In addition to the traits found in your tortrum heritage, select one of the following gifts.

Snapping Jaws

You gain a bite attack that on a hit deals 1d4 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier slashing damage, whichever is highest. When you hit with your bite attack, the target must succeed on an Athletics check versus your maneuver DC or become grappled by you. Creatures who are grappled in this fashion may repeat their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

Steady Stance

You have advantage on saving throws made to resist being knocked prone by nonmagical means. Additionally, the circumference of your shell makes it harder for smaller limbs to wrap themselves around you. You cannot be grappled by any creature that is a Size category smaller than you.

Withdraw

As an action, you may withdraw your limbs and head into your shell. While withdrawn you cannot move or take actions and are considered to be blinded, but gain a +2 bonus to your AC and resistance to nonmagical piercing and slashing damage. You may remain withdrawn for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution modifier, though you may choose to emerge from your shell before the duration is up as a bonus action. You may use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Tortrum Paragon

When you reach 10th level, you become a better tortrum and gain one paragon gift from the following list.

Reflective Shell

When you are hit with a spell that has a range other than self or touch, roll [[/r 1d6]] and consult the following table for its effect:

1 - 2

You are affected by the spell as normal

3 - 4

The spell is reflected off of your shell in a random @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-roll-tables.RollTable.XS8Cwgj70GtbcNo1]{direction} determined by the Narrator. Any damage that a creature in the spell’s area of effect would take uses the spellcaster’s statistics and save DC for the purposes of saving throws and damage calculations.

5 - 6

The spell is reflected off of your shell in a random direction determined by the Narrator. Any damage that a creature in the spell’s area of effect would take uses the spellcaster’s statistics and save DC for the purposes of saving throws and damage calculations.

Once you have used this ability, you may not do so again until you complete a short or a long rest.

Unshakable Resolve

You learn the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-maneuvers.Item.424e61mejvwzym0c]{Unstoppable} combat maneuver. It does not count against the number of combat maneuvers you know, and you may activate it once per long rest without expending any exertion.
